<div class="gy-contact">

      <h2>Let's Share More Stories of Abundance</h2>
      <p>The Green Yard explores the different ways people around the world live with abundance through plants, food, and edible landscapes. Whether you're growing in a small backyard or on a large farm, there's always something we can learn from one another.</p>

          <p>Have a food forest, edible backyard, community garden, regenerative farm, or another unique growing space you'd like featured? I'm always interested in discovering new gardens and meeting the people behind them, in Arizona and around the world.</p>
          <p>Tell me a little about your garden, where you're located, and what makes your space special. Photos or links are always welcome!</p>

          <p>Are you a grower, creator, organization, or business interested in working with The Green Yard? I'd love to hear your ideas for garden tours, creative projects, and partnerships that celebrate growing food and connecting with nature.</p>
          <p>General questions, suggestions, and feedback are welcome too.</p>

          <p>Interested in growing your own food, creating an edible landscape, or starting a backyard food forest?</p>
          <p>I'm developing future classes designed to help people grow with confidence, whether you're just getting started or looking to expand your existing garden.</p>
          <p>Join the class waitlist to be notified when new learning opportunities become available.</p>
